newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers quiet, demand moderate.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers quiet, demand moderate.

text.p: Rotterdam and Antwerp bunker prices were little changed in quiet trade on Tuesday, brokers said.
They put total ARA demand at a moderate 25,000 tonnes with supply increasing gradually.
In both ports 380 cst bunker fuel was pegged at $85 a tonne and 180 cst at $91. Diesel and gas oil both rose by $5 and $10 to $155 and $170 respectively.
Fuel oil barges were similarly quiet, trading between $81 and $82.50 during the morning.
Hamburg bunkers were no livelier than ARA, with 380 cst pegged at $94/96 and 180 cst at $99/$102, while supply was reported to be good in the Med amid average to low demand.

At Fos 380 cst was quoted at $94 and 180 cst at $100, with Augusta prices some $6-7 higher. Algeciras prices were some $3 firmer than Monday, with 380 cst at $97/99 and 180 cst at $103/4, brokers said.
